biggest_catch: The new membership must stay open 12 months - if the friend's account closes earlier, your $25 is revoked and deducted.
catches: Referring member earns $25 for each successful referral (the friend opening a new membership).
Limit 4 referrals per member per month ($100/month).
Referred member must qualify for membership (Adams, Cumberland, Franklin, Fulton, or York County, PA with exclusions).
New membership must remain open for 12 months after opening or the incentive is revoked and deducted from the remaining account balance.
The extra $25 (Visa card) and $50 (checking with $300/pay direct deposit) incentives go to the NEW member, not the referrer.
1st Ed reserves the right to terminate the program at any time.
No tax language on the page (standard bonus treatment; not stated).

Friend qualifies for membership and opens a new membership.
Both accounts must be in good standing.
You earn $25 per successful referral (up to 4/month, $100/month).

when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: $25 credited when the new membership is open; revoked if closed within 12 months. — structural: the bonus requires a 12-month funding/balance hold before it is even earned.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 12-month hold is structural — this route cannot pay fast under any reading of the terms.
